transfer.stem: Which notes match the class display?
transfer.passage:
A nature-study display
Our class was preparing a display for the school nature-study day. We planned how to enjoy nature without disturbing wildlife. At the art table, we used natural light to help us see the colours accurately. "Open the window to let fresh air in," our teacher said.
The next section was about fish. Its heading read, "Fish need oxygen dissolved in the water." Beside it, we placed a note explaining that burning fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide. We checked the two substance names before arranging the cards.
For the history section, we chose a description of an old station that once stored coal for steam trains. A separate photograph showed smoke rising from a chimney into cold air. At the end of the activity, our teacher asked us to sort the metal separately from the paper.

options.text: Fish need oxygen dissolved in water; fossil-fuel burning releases carbon dioxide; metal should be grouped separately from paper.
Fish do not need oxygen; fossil-fuel burning releases only oxygen; metal and paper belong in one mixed group.
Fish need oxygen dissolved in water; the carbon-dioxide note refers only to pure carbon; metal should be grouped separately from paper.
Fish need only dry air outside water; fossil-fuel burning releases carbon dioxide; metal and paper belong in one mixed group.

answer.display: Fish need oxygen dissolved in water; fossil-fuel burning releases carbon dioxide; metal should be grouped separately from paper.
